name: AJAX Comments
description: Module makes comments load without a page refresh via AJAX
project_description:
Provides ajax comments to Drupal sites (commenting like a social networking sites: Facebook, Google+, vk.com etc).

 Features: 

 - Makes AJAX submits

 - Allows replies to comments on the actual thread page

 - AJAX comments deleting

 - Node.js integration (realtime comments capability like a live chat)

 - Works with CAPTCHA

 - Cool jQuery sliding

 - Views integration

 - Compatible with Comment goodness module (comment sorting by the update date)

 - Compatible with Display Suite module

 - Compatible with Comment sort by created module (comment sorting by the creation date)

 - Compatible with Fivestar module

- Compatible with Advanced Forum module (you should use "Keep default CSS classes" Advanced Forum option)

 - Easy to use, just download and enable module
